comment:

variables.name: DESCRIPTION_KEY_MEDIA_URI
variables.comment:

     * framework class) when parceling/converting to and from framework objects.

     * @hide

variables.name: DESCRIPTION_KEY_NULL_BUNDLE_FLAG
variables.comment:

     *
     * @hide
